name: West Bay Club
positioning: Intimate oceanfront resort of studios and suites on the widest stretch of Grace Bay Beach, Providenciales
best_for: Families and groups who want multi-bedroom oceanfront suites with kitchens
Couples looking to unwind on a quiet stretch of Grace Bay Beach

facts.text: West Bay Club sits on the widest stretch of Grace Bay Beach.
West Bay Club is an intimate oceanfront resort.
Contemporary Caribbean style defines every studio and suite.
Accommodations feature oceanfront living spaces, spa-inspired bathrooms and fully equipped kitchens or kitchenettes.
The Oceanfront Luxury One Bedroom Suite has a bathroom with an oversized soaking tub, separate shower and double vanity.
The Oceanfront Luxury Four Bedroom Suite is designed for larger groups and families, with a large private terrace overlooking Grace Bay.
Suites are equipped with kitchens, washers and dryers.
The resort offers a Kids' Club.
A pre-arrival concierge can arrange excursions and activities before guests arrive, and personal concierges book excursions on site.
Excursions range from short kayak tours to full-day trips to uninhabited islands.
A Saxophone Sunset Sail features a live local saxophonist on board a sailing catamaran.
The fitness center has strength and cardio equipment.

highlights.text: The resort sits on a vast and quiet stretch of Grace Bay Beach, at a remove from the resort district crowds.
The Premier Oceanfront Three Bedroom Suite offers 3,800 square feet on the top floor, with two oceanfront balconies and a third balcony with panoramic island views.
Studios and suites feature oceanfront living spaces, spa-inspired bathrooms and fully equipped kitchens or kitchenettes.
The Deluxe Half-Day Reef Snorkel goes by luxury catamaran to the Turks and Caicos Barrier Reef, with an island picnic lunch on a deserted beach.

considerations.text: The resort is on a quiet stretch of Grace Bay Beach, set apart from the busier resort district.
WhataHotel notes limited dining options on-site.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires advance planning.
